$comment: Every `Discover*` filter that excludes a subject the world contains and does not publish a reason. `tools/check-stardew-discovery-exclusions.mjs` names each entry whose function no longer exists or no longer filters on `member` (backlog_stale), each entry whose `token` is now in the closed vocabulary (backlog_token_available - the family can publish today), and each entry whose disposition names no class (backlog_unreasoned). Classes: 'token pending: <state>' (the state has no token yet), 'not vanilla: <who deletes it>' (the engine does not refuse this; the filter is a defect), 'kind test: <why the member names this family's subject rather than a state it withholds>'.

entries.disposition: kind test: the family's SUBJECT is a felled tree - `stump.Value` selects it rather than withholding a standing tree from it. The state reason `stump` belongs to `chop_tree`, which has it.
kind test: `growthStage >= Tree.treeStage` selects a mature felled tree; a sapling cannot be felled at all, so there is no withheld subject to count.

kind test: `health == 5f` selects the exact durability `Tree.performTreeFall` writes on the hit that fells a tree (`stump.Value = true; health.Value = 5f;`, Tree.cs:1495-1496) - a postcondition readback, not a target list that could withhold a subject.
kind test: `chop_stump`'s subject IS the stump; the predicate selects it. The `stump` reason belongs to `chop_tree`, which excludes it.
kind test: `shake_tree`'s subject is a standing tree; a felled one belongs to `chop_stump`, so nothing a shake could act on is withheld.
